c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text169: Great! It seems like everything is about to start so we need to hurry if we want to make it in time.
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text170: Wow! It turns out that we are pretty good at decorating things. I can't wait to get to the party itself! Let's bounce!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text171: Hurrah! It was unforgettable! The holiday was a success, and sweets will last for a long time!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text172: We've had the sweetest time! The memories about this evening will fill us up with joy wherever we'll go next. By the way, it's time to move!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text173: Well, it was all a dream although it felt so real! But now we're awake and full of energy for new accomplishments!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text174: It turned out masterfully! Let's see what will happen next? Hope something very interesting!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text175: As much as we enjoy breathing in candy flowered aroma we need to move on! Hopefully thhe smell will stay with us for a while!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text176: We've had so much fun and we're so excited about what happens next! With the power of snow on our side we're ready for new miracles!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text177: Wow, that was fast! And very, very cool. Too bad we have to go already!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text178: All that preparation got me in the mood for celebration! I can't wait for festivities to start now!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text179: I guess we have enough candies to make our Christmas tree look delicious and to even treat ourselves to some cupcakes!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text180: It was a fantastic journey into the sky which we'll always cherish! Now it's the time for the next chapter of our incredible adventure!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text181: It was unbelievable! I hope that we and our new friend will have a great time celebrating and spreading around the Christmas spirit!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text182: It would've been nice to stay here for a while and enjoy the serenity of local streams but the most exciting part our journey is still ahead of us
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text183: This was wonderful! Is it possible to top that? We shall find out very soon!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text184: It was quite a remarkable part of our journey! Now we are looking forward to even more!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text185: New emotions, new friends and new experiences! This is the way to spend time and we can't get enough of it! Let's find another adventure!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text186: We can't explain how did we get here but we were destined to do just that. Let's see where our curiosity takes us next!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text187: Thanks for letting us savour the moment and giving us a chance to catch our breath. Now we are ready for new challenges!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text188: There is always a place for sweet feelings in the candy kingdom!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text189: Just as we predicted! Nobody wants to leave this place but the adventure calls. And it tastes better than anything!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text190: Although it's so relaxing and satisfying it's also kind of boring. We weren't made to idle. We are destined to be the greatest travelers in the world! Let's roll!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text191: Although it's very nice to be surrounded by this colorful nature we can't help ourselves but think where does this bridge lead? Let's find out!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text192: Well, it looks like a beginning of some new adventure. Our hopes are up and our spirits are high. Let's find out what's next!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text193: We're glad that we seized this opportunity to spend some time alone with nature. This gave us the energy we'll need on the next leg of the journey!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text194: The celebration is coming to an end! But it doesn't mean that the fun has to stop. We can feel the presence of adventure in the air!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text195: It was great staying at grandma's house! You can't find as many delicious treats as she has in the whole wide Candyland! But we'll try!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text196: It turns out that if you're friendly to others others will be friendly to you! This lesson will come in handy when we continue our journey.
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text197: That was so much fun! We hope to see even more gorgeous flowers on our way. As for now, let's carry this amazing scent with us and let others enjoy it.
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text198: How cool was that! Hopefully, one day we'll have a chance to build the house of our own for others to awe. As for now, the adventure is calling!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text199: We’ve decided to let the faith choose for us. Was going right the right decision? We’ll find out soon enough!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text200: There are many new adventures ahead of us but one thing is for sure. Every acquaintance on our way makes the experience so much better!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text201: We should thank our friend for keeping us on track because it's easy to get lost while gazing at the landmarks. Let's find out where she takes us next!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text202: The photo turned out just perfect! A simple act of looking at it will give us the strength we need to go that extra mile when another great journey requires that of us.
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text203: It seems like we've seen all there is to see. We doubt that anything will ever top our encounter with the Rainbow Unicorn but we're willing to find out!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text204: This was a perfect journey through the most wonderful ice crystals and sundae rivers. We can't wait to see what's coming next!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text205: Once again our rule paid off. We had a great time and enjoyed every second of it! We hope you did too because it's time to go now.
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text206: Fully rested, we are ready to see what this place has to offer. Let's get the most out of this wonderful opportunity!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text207: Our loot is delicious. Thank you for helping us to collect all these sweets. We will see you on another island!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text208: We live for exploring new places and cultures. Thank you for being a part of our team on this journey!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text209: Instead of going to the lake like everyone else we decided to visit one of our favorite places. Thank you for coming with us!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text210: Thank you for joining us! We had a lovely time together. Now we feel like going somewhere else. We hope that you'll come with us!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text211: We've had a great time sightseeing but it's far from the end. We have lots more to witness!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text212: Thanks for taking part in our amazing adventure. We hope that we can do even greater things in the future!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text213: It feels great to expand the horizons and see new things. There is no better way to do it than embracing the spirit of history!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text214: We had a lot of fun building the chocolate bridge together. Thank you for your help. It's about time we cross it!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text215: We're so happy that you're keeping us company on our journeys. We're sure that many more lie ahead of us!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text216: Thank you for keeping us company! You collected enough sweets to build a chocolate bench for everyone.
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text217: It's always better to travel together because you can share the excitement with your friends. Thank you for being a part of it all!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text218: Thank you for helping us realize our dream! It would've been impossible to assemble the carriage without all the sweets you collected.
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text219: It wasn't easy to climb this ladder while avoiding sticky caramel but we made it thanks to you. With friends like this anything is possible!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text220: We hope that you had as much fun swinging as we did! It was totally awesome and we can't wait to find even more ways to enjoy life!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text221: Thank you so much! It looks like we have enough treats to continue our exciting journey!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text222: Thank you so much for rescuing us on such a short notice! All this light you brought with you made it possible for us to collect even more treats.
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text223: Full of hopes and dreams  we are ready to charge forward to even sweeter journeys!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text224: We made it! All thanks to you. The best part is that this little journey was just a first step in a much greater adventure!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text225: We hope that you enjoyed it as much as we did. And judging by the number of sweets we collected you did!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text226: It was a lot of fun playing together! We hope that we can keep doing that even when there is more snow.
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text227: It was nice to enjoy some hot beverages and having fun at the rink but it's now time to move on!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text228: We had a great time with our snowball fight! We hope you can join us for our next adventure!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text229: We hope that you enjoyed it as much as we did because it's now time to dig even deeper!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text230: We hope that the next year will bring us even more delicious sweets that we will share with everyone!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text231: It's a very long road and we have to rest if we want to make it. Let's move!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text232: Great job crossing the bridge and avoiding all the traps! We're one step closer to our destination.
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text233: We don't know if our paths will cross again in the future but it doesn't really matter. We've had a great time together and we are ready for a new journey.
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text234: It was a very beautiful and soothing dream. We didn't want to wake up but it's time to go. We'll keep these memories forever!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text235: This sweet little cub turned out to be the cutest creature! We wish we could take him with us but he belongs to the wildlife.
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text236: We told you that it's going to be fun! Thank you for taking the time and keeping us company. We hope to see you soon on our next journey!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text237: Thank you for that wonderful time! And for all the sweets you helped us collect. It made this trip truly special. See you soon on another adventure!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text238: You've done an amazing job! This trip was already fun but your invaluable contribution made it even better. We can't wait to see you soon!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text239: It was too much sugar even for us! We hope you enjoyed this trip too. Let's take a little break and prepare for our next adventure!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text240: It was great! Especially considering the fact that we've never performed before. We'll only get better from here!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text241: It wasn't easy but we did it. Another excellent performance under our belt. You deserve all this fame and glory as much as we do!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text242: We don't know about you but it was a blast for us! Let's take a moment to catch our breath and move on.
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text243: Now you can tell everyone that danger is your second name! Thank you so much for you help. We can't wait to see you again soon.
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text244: We'll have a lot of wonderful memories about this area and the fun we had here together. But let's embark on a new adventure!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text245: It's to early to tell what we should expect from this new beginning but we're excited nonetheless. Hopefully, you're too!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text246: It's unclear yet what will this rivalry come to but the beginning is always exciting! Let's move on to the next stage to see what will happen!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text247: We’re on top again all thanks to you! The best way we can pay you back is by inviting you on our next adventure which starts very soon!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text248: We certainly do not regret inviting you to this incredible performance. We believe that if you stay with us a little bit longer even more miracles will be revealed!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text249: It was an exciting challenge and we’re very glad that you could make it. Are you ready for the next adventure?
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text250: It was a pretty close and epic battle! Thank you for playing with us. Don't go away for too long. Our new adventure is about to begin!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text251: It was some delicious harvest! Let’s sow even more seeds the next season. Now it’s time for another adventure.
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text252: We can definitely say that we still want to have our own farm someday but it’s too early to settle down since there are many fun adventures ahead of us!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text253: It was definitely a lot of fun! I hope as we go deeper into this forest we could find even more exciting things!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text254: I hope you know that we’re just getting started? You’re obviously ready to give it all you have but remember that slow and steady wins the race.
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text255: We hope that you've learned something new. We definitely did – there is no such thing as too much fun!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text256: We told you that it’s going to be delightful! We hope that the next time we’re going to celebrate something you’re going to join us without a single doubt!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text257: It was very spooky and we loved it! Let’s hope that the potion will last us until next Halloween so we could move on and embark on other adventures!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text258: We know that it’s just a tip of the iceberg but it’s a great way to start with donut making. Let’s go and see what else can we learn about!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text259: Another summit is conquered! We climbed this cone-shaped mountain. Not without your help, of course. The view from here is amazing and we can already see new adventures.
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text260: Looks are often deceiving and learning how to make cookies is a living proof of that. It wasn’t as easy as we expected but we managed with your help!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text261: Thank you for accepting our invitation. We hope that you had as much fun as we did. Let’s go and look for more things to do!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text262: Yes, it has already become cold. But it's great that friends can warm each other with their warmth and care!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text263: Great, now we know penguins love ice cream too! But could it be bad for their stomach?
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text264: It was a wonderful journey but it doesn’t have to end here. Let’s say goodbye to Santa and look for more!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text265: Our winter journey continues! And it’s full of magical encounters. Let’s see what happens next.
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text266: It was cold outside but we didn’t even notice the weather since we were having a lot of fun! It’s time to see what we’ll discover next.
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text267: If it wasn’t awesome we do not know what will be! Have a little rest but don’t get too comfortable because another journey is ahead of us.
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text268: We are extremely happy but absolutely exhausted! Let’s regain our strength and start exercising our brain so our bodies can relax.
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text269: We’ve done a great job all thanks to you! Now the Candyland will shine even brighter!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text270: Maybe we were a bit dramatic when calling it dangerous… But who wants to stick to the river and get carried away by the current? Let’s find a more convenient spot!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text271: It was a wonderful journey into the spring but it doesn’t have to end here. Let’s explore Candyland in more details!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text272: It was a magical night! Thank you for being a part of it. Let’s see how many more great thing we can do together.
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text273: We hope that you enjoyed our unplanned vacation as much as we did. Stay with us to have even more fun!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text274: It was incredible! We collected lots of delicious sweets and walked one of the greatest paths Candyland has to offer. Let’s find out what’s next!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text275: Reinvigorated and with pockets full of sweets, we’re ready to continue our journey towards the most exciting adventures!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text276: It was a wonderful and relaxing experience but it’s time to spice things up a bit. And we know just a place for that!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text277: It turns out that everything is possible when you act as a team. And we are a pretty good one. Let’s see what more we are capable of.
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text278: Everything about the star cake was as promised! We don’t remember the last time sweets tasted so good. We can’t wait to see what expects us next!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text279: It was a truly incredible journey! Let’s see what else we can discover together!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text280: We had so much fun spending time with you. It would be great to continue our joint journey!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text281: We don’t remember the last time we ate so much blackberry and blueberry! Let’s see what else we can find together.
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text282: It was a great game of chess. We thank you for playing with us and hope to see you again very soon!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text283: There is no road we cannot walk together! It’s time to find a new adventure we can embark on!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text284: We had a wonderful time and are now fully invigorated for new achievements!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text285: It was a truly delicious journey! Let’s see if we can find an even better place.
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text286: Although we love purple, it’s been enough. Let’s find some new place with new colors!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text287: This was a fantastic experience but it’s freezing here. Let’s move on!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text288: We had a great time and are ready to visit new places and try new things!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text289: We nearly drowned in those sands. I hope we can refresh ourselves further on!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text290: It was a thrilling journey. Let's see what lies ahead!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text291: Those clouds were so fluffy. Let's take a break at the next location!
c.FinishEpisodeWindow.Text292: Gingerbread house was very tasty. What will we be able to try next?

c.CollectFireworkTutorial: You get an Ice Cream Cup for combining five or more elements! Match it with the same color to use!
c.level20TutorialStep1: Rolling Pin is available! It will collect any column of sweets. Select the Rolling Pin!
c.level20TutorialStep2: Use the Rolling Pin to collect sweets in this column!
c.level18TutorialStep1: A blue donut is tied up and can’t be moved. Let’s untie the bow!
c.level26TutorialStep1: Rainbow Rocket is available! It will collect all the sweets with matching colors, let’s try it!
c.level26TutorialStep2: Collect all the red stars using the Rainbow Rocket!
c.level16TutorialStep1: These are Soda Cups! Get them to the bottom row to collect. Move the Cup to the row below by matching the donuts!
c.level16TutorialStep2: Time for the final step: make a line with the cupcakes to move the Soda Cup to the bottom and collect it!
c.level23TutorialStep1: Match three Green Cupcakes next to a Chocolate Bar to slightly open it up!
c.level23TutorialStep2: Now, match the Blue Donuts to reveal the Chocolate Bar a little bit more!
c.level23TutorialStep3: And, finally, match the Red Stars to collect the Chocolate Bar!
c.level31TutorialStep1: Match the sweets near the burgers to remove them!
c.level46TutorialStep1: This is an ice cream maker! Match four different lines next to it to make it work! Let's start with the line of stars!
c.level46TutorialStep3: Let’s do same with the third!
c.level61TutorialStep1: Cells with cookies help you add extra points to the sweets which you can use during your next turn. Match donuts in a line!
c.level61TutorialStep2: Now match the jellies in line and you will get an additional bonus to the one you already have!
c.level70TutorialStep1: Time for advanced moves! Swap the sweets to make two Rainbow Cakes!
c.level70TutorialStep2: Swap Rainbow Cakes with each other to clear all the cells on the field!
c.level76TutorialStep1: There are so many butterflies! Let's catch some! Match a line to collect them!
c.level106TutorialStep1: These are Jam Pots! Let's match blue Jam Pot with some Blue Donuts!
c.level106TutorialStep2: With your each move the Jam in the Pot becomes hotter getting ready to explode! Remove the second Pot or it will explode on the next move!
c.level121TutorialStep1: There is Jam everywhere! Try to get ice cream cones out of that mess!
c.level121TutorialStep2: Oh! It continues to spread! Match sweets next to the Jam covered cell to clean it! The Jam will stop spreading during that move.
c.level151TutorialStep1: Don't be scared! It's just honey. Match a line on the honey covered cell to collect it.
c.level181TutorialStep1: Line up the sweets next to a lollipop to unwrap it! You can see how many sweet matches you need on the counter.
c.level196TutorialStep1: Look! It's a cookie-man! You should move it to the bottom row. But there is a tricky part! Match a line with the ice cream cones to see what happens!
c.level196TutorialStep2: If you don't move the cookie-man down, he will climb up! Match the jellies in a line and find out what the cookie-man will do.
c.level226TutorialStep1: Let's see what's in these boxes. Match the sweets in a line next to them! There might be something curious inside!
c.level256TutorialStep1: It's a box for donuts! Let's fill it!
c.level256TutorialStep2: See! The first donut is already there! Match a line one more time!
c.level256TutorialStep3: Wow! You're doing great! Another one is in the box! Let's do the same again!
c.level256TutorialStep4: Good job! Match the final line to fill the box with donuts!
c.level286TutorialStep1: Let's bake a Gingerbread house! Move each ingredient to the bottom of the field! Try doing this, for example.
c.level286TutorialStep2: Excellent! Now do the same with the roof!
c.level316TutorialStep1: Match a line to untie the boxes!
c.level316TutorialStep2: Match one more line to open them, just like you did before!
c.level346TutorialStep1: Line up the ice cream with other sweets of the same color and see what happens!
c.level376TutorialStep1: Each cake has four sides. Match a line next to each of them to collect the respective pieces!
c.level406TutorialStep1: Match a line to clear the cells from the muffins!
c.level406TutorialStep2: Note that some muffins have a cherry on top! Collect one more!
c.level436TutorialStep1: It's a caterpillar's house! New caterpillar shows up every four moves. Make a move to see how it works!
c.level466TutorialStep1: It's a gum machine! Charge it by matching lines next to it and the gum will hit five random targets!
c.level466TutorialStep2: Match a line one more time!
c.level466TutorialStep3: Release the gum by matching this line!
c.level496TutorialStep1: Jam Jar releases jam every four moves. Match a line next to it to prevent that!
c.level526TutorialStep1: To collect waffles line them up with the elements colored as the waffle filling!
c.level556TutorialStep1: Match a line to lit a candle!
c.level556TutorialStep2: Be careful! If you match a line next to a lit candle it will go out!
c.level586TutorialStep1: Match a line to get rid of a wrapper!
c.level586TutorialStep2: Look! We've found a chocolate rabbit! Match a line of jellies to collect it!
c.level616TutorialStep1: Lollipops! They change in color with every move! Match a line and see what happens!
c.level616TutorialStep2: Lollipops have changed their color! Notice that this a recurring process!
c.level646TutorialStep1: It's a bow! Match a line with the decorated elements to remove a ribbon.
c.level676TutorialStep1: The sweets in the bag can't be moved! Make a color matching line next to the bags to see what's inside!
c.level706TutorialStep1: Look's like the puppy is a fan of ice cream! Match a line of cones to feed it!
c.level736TutorialStep1: To collect a lily make a color matching line with it three times. Note that lily always shows the order of its future hues!
c.level766TutorialStep1: Little colorful men appear at the bottom and then climb up! Try collecting them before they vanish by making a color matching line!
c.level811TutorialStep1: To set off a bomb make a color matching line three times! Let's make a first step!
c.level856TutorialStep1: Make a color matching line to break the ice!
c.level976TutorialStep1: It's a stream! It progresses elements one cell forward with your every move! Match a line to see how it works.
c.level1036TutorialStep1: To grow a lawn make a special line where one of the elements is on the grass and the other is not.
c.level1096TutorialStep1: Match a line next to a jar to release a firefly!
c.level1156TutorialStep1: Match all the necessary colors next to the firecrackers to blow them up. The color you use will activate a corresponding firecracker!
c.level1216TutorialStep1: Match a line on a cell with ivy to keep it from growing!
c.level1276TutorialStep1: Match a line next to a bottle to fill it! Do it again using the same color to collect it!
c.level1336TutorialStep1: Bee makes honey every move. Match a line next to it to stop it!
c.level1396TutorialStep1: Fries will take away one of your every fourth move. You can remove them from the field by matching a line nearby.
c.level1411TutorialStep1: By matching a line next to the cookie you will add the specified amount of moves!
c.level1456TutorialStep1: The barrier won't let you move the elements that are inside of it!
c.level1516TutorialStep1: Match a line to collect a gum! Some pieces of gum require more matches to be collected!
c.level1576TutorialStep1: You need to collect the top petal. In order to do that, match a line next to it using the corresponding color!
c.level1636TutorialStep1: Make a color matching line by the candle as many times as displayed on the counter to see what happens!
c.level1696TutorialStep1: Match a line next to a muffin to take it out the packaging!
c.level1756TutorialStep1: Match a line by the bottle of mustard as many times as displayed on the counter to make a shot. Note that the bottle will change the direction after that!
c.level1816TutorialStep1: Ice tiles will freeze any element that stays on them for more than one move!

c.level1TutorialStep1: Collect donuts and jellies! Match lines next to the goal elements to add extra points to them. Note that any multiplier will disappear with your next move!
c.level2TutorialStep1: A blue hero is available! Match four blue donuts to create the blue hero!
c.level2TutorialStep2: Match a line with the hero to activate him! He will add multipliers to goal element or turn random sweets into heroes.
c.level3TutorialStep1: Match a line with five elements to make a rainbow cake!
c.level3TutorialStep2: Swapping the cake with any element will remove all the elements of that color from the field!
c.level4TutorialStep1: Make lines on the cells with honey to collect it.
c.level4TutorialStep2: Each level has a number of moves. This amount decreases by one with every step you make. Collect the required elements before running out of moves.
c.level5TutorialStep1: Wow! Another hero! Let's summon him by matching four stars! Do not forget to activate his power!
c.level6TutorialStep1: To open the box match a line next to it. Some boxes require more than one match to be opened.
c.level7TutorialStep1: The new hero has joined us! Summon him by matching a line of four ice cream cones! Do not forget to activate his power!
c.level8TutorialStep1: It is time for crazy combos! Swap two cakes with each other and they will blow up everything on the field!
c.level9TutorialStep1: The great warrior will join us if you match a line of four green cupcakes! Activate him to see what he is capable of!
c.level10TutorialStep1: Feed the mouse with donuts! The necessary amount is displayed on the counter under it!
c.level12TutorialStep1: Caterpillar blocks an element it sits on. Make a match to get rid of it!
c.level13TutorialStep1: The Spoon is available! It will collect any single sweet from any cell. Let’s try it out!
c.level13TutorialStep2: Use The Spoon on the cell with honey to collect it!
